profile.role_note: Glacio Chafe specialist; converts Chafe stacks into Glacio Bite for burst.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: The elite Glacio hypercarry and the best payoff for the Chafe mechanic; worth pulling if you want a top-tier Glacio DPS, though she wants Chafe enablers like Lucilla or Chisa around her.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Frostburn (or Emerald of Genesis / Red Spring) + 5-piece Wishes of Quiet Snowfall in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Reminiscence: Threnodian - Voidborne Construct in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Glacio DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, a ~70:250 Crit balance, and 120% Energy Regen.

ranked_weapons.name: Frostburn
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature; tailor-made for her Glacio Chafe kit. Best in slot.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Brilliance
ranked_weapons.note: High base ATK and Crit DMG; strong stat stick.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Standard-banner sword; Crit Rate, ATK%, and Energy Regen.

ranked_weapons.name: Red Spring
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate substat with Basic Attack synergy.

ranked_weapons.name: Feather Edge
ranked_weapons.note: Craftable 4-star; refine it high for a solid F2P option.

ranked_weapons.name: Fable is Wisdom
ranked_weapons.note: Another usable 4-star for players without 5-star swords.

echo_sets.name: Wishes of Quiet Snowfall
echo_sets.note: Her dedicated Glacio Chafe set; amplifies her Liberation-centric damage after Chafe application.

stat_priorities.note: Glacio DMG on both; ATK% is close behind if substats are better.

teams.name: Premium: Hiyuki + Lucilla + Suisui

members.name: Hiyuki
members.note: The Chafe hypercarry; converts Glacio Chafe into Glacio Bite for her burst windows.

members.name: Lucilla
members.note: Best-in-slot Glacio Chafe applicator with Glacio-related buffs for Hiyuki.

members.name: Suisui
members.note: Raises the max stack limit of Glacio Chafe and provides healing plus general DMG buffs.

teams.rotation: Suisui opens to build Forte and cast her buffs, Outro to Lucilla for Chafe application and her Reminiscence-mode nuke, then Hiyuki takes the field: hold Heavy to fill Forte, build Chafe, and detonate with Liberation.

teams.name: Alternative: Hiyuki + Lynae + Chisa

members.name: Hiyuki
members.note: Same Chafe-conversion carry; benefits from Lynae's Liberation amplification.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: General DMG buffs including Resonance Liberation DMG amplification, which Hiyuki scales off.

members.name: Chisa
members.note: Raises the Chafe stack limit and reduces enemy DEF; enables Glacio Chafe to new heights.

teams.rotation: Chisa opens to raise the Chafe stack cap and shred DEF, Lynae drops her buff window, then Hiyuki runs her standard Chafe-build-and-detonate rotation.

tier_badge.label: Meta-defining
tier_badge.note: Elite Glacio hypercarry; the Chafe mechanic's best payoff.
